title: Three Years and One Short Badge
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：membership　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 membership 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the secretary ① held the membership that no player in the club would have recorded, and he said the holding was the whole of the year. The ② membership, meaning the seat itself and not the badge, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a membership, he said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ membership in that club had the same short badge beside it, and the ④ membership at the far desk, meaning the fee they kept for the children to pay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A membership, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the secretary said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the membership was the whole of the matter, meaning the right and not the seat. The ⑥ membership, meaning the right and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; membership, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a seat and a right. He said the right is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ membership had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short badge. The ⑧ membership of the whole thing, the secretary wrote in February, was one club and three years of recording; membership, he said, is either the fee at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ membership I remember is the seat recorded in the register, which closed in 2000 and is still recorded as the quietest in the club. A ⑩ membership, my mother said in 2002, is the only seat that improves by being recorded; every membership, she said, is a right that has agreed to look like a seat. She said the right was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 会员资格；会员身份（指俱乐部里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 会员资格；会员身份（指那份会员资格本身，与徽章相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the membership 持有这份会员资格
D. n. 会员资格；会员身份（指留给孩子们交的那一项那一份）
E. n. 入会之事（抽象总称，指一处俱乐部的会员资格之事）
F. n. 会员资格；会员身份（指会员名册里写到、被登记的的那一份）
G. n. 权利、名分（指一件事里人人都入却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 名分（抽象总称，指人人都入却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the membership that no player in the club would have recorded
The membership, meaning the seat itself and not the badge
the membership at the far desk
the membership was the whole of the matter
the membership had become a line in a register
The membership of the whole thing
A membership, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: hold the membership 意为“持有这份会员资格”，1993 年那位干事把俱乐部里没有一位会员肯登记的一份会员资格做了一遍。
membership 意为“会员资格；会员身份”，指那份会员资格本身而不是徽章，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被登记。
membership 意为“会员资格；会员身份”，指俱乐部里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一枚小小的徽章。
membership 意为“会员资格；会员身份”，指最远那张前台留给孩子们交的那一项那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
membership 意为“权利、名分”，指一件事里人人都入却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份权利就是那件事的全部。
membership 意为“名分”，指人人都入却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份会员资格，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
membership 意为“会员资格；会员身份”，指会员名册里写到、被登记的的那一份，到 1998 年这一份成了会员名册里的一行。
membership 意为“入会之事”，干事二月写道，整件事的会员资格之事是一处俱乐部和三个年份的登记。
membership 意为“会员资格；会员身份”，我记得的是会员名册里登记过的那一份，2000 年办完了，至今仍被说成俱乐部里最安静的一份。
membership 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，会员资格是唯一会因为被好好登记而变得更好的会员资格。
